ShortDescription.Value: Manage Cemeteries, Crematoriums, hearses, or auto manage. Bonus Status report.

Publish.LongDescription:
**Magic Hearse + Funeral Director** does not turn off deathcare loop; normal vanilla deathcare systems run. See below for details.
- Control Crematoriums and Cemeteries without in-city bloat that reduces performance. - Cemetery overflow is handled - no stuck full cemeteries. - Choose if you want to self-manage crematorium processing, hearses, cemetery capacity/turnover, and more. - or if you prefer auto-clean of death notices. - Status report can be used with no other functions enabled! It is Worth checking out!
### Option 1: Funeral Director (Self manage)
Adjust Buildings:
- Crematorium processing - Total Hearses (max hearses per facility) - Hearse speed (pedal to the metal) - Cemetery storage multiplier - Choose Auto reset cemetery or gradual Cemetery turnover rate - Maximum workers. - Leave Adjust workers OFF if you prefer ConfigXML or another mod to control deathcare worker numbers. - Funeral Director does not run per-frame; sliders make changes, then mod goes idle, basically no city impact.
### Option 2: Automatic
- Removes corpses if they are waiting for a hearse. - Great for death-waves and notification spam. Lightweight design for best city performance. - This does not turn off death system, it's just a faster clear of death notices.
## Bonus Status Report - All major death stats - finally we know how many are Dead!! - Scan only happens when Options requests Status or when Log Report is pressed (no city per-frame Status scan).
## Features - Toggle on/off without restarting the game. - Safe to remove any time. Uncheck both boxes to disable everything. - Disable other hearse mods to avoid conflicts! - Use either Self-manage or auto clean (mutually exclusive). - No Harmony (more reliable on patch days).
## Support and Feedback - If the mod works for you, give it a like, easiest way to support free mods! - Feedback: GitHub or Discord links on the right.
## Credits - River-Mochi: author - yenyang: technical consultant - Inspired by Wayz's original Magical Hearse (retired) - Toud: Polish translation review - StarQ: tech advisory - Obelix, Toud, Necko1996: release testing, screenshots
### 16 Languages Hello, Bonjour, Hallo, Hola, Ciao, こんにちは, 안녕하세요, 你好, Cześć, Olá, Merhaba, Привіт, Xin chào, สวัสดี
## How it works
- Only if using Magic mode ✅ if there is a corpse and it needs transport, it's cleaned up. Looks like magic but the secret is flags. - Mod does not stop death - it's just very fast corpse cleanup. - Safe removal: if you used sliders, you can remove the mod, and keep same values on buildings until they are deleted. Or set sliders to 100% > uncheck Funeral Director > save city one time (fast vanilla reset). - Bonus: disable all checkboxes ✅, turns off all mod death work, and still see real Status reports in the Options menu. - Status only works when inside the menu; no performance impact to in-game city.
Publish.ChangeLog: - Added a slider to Increase the time a hearse has to pick up a corpse before icons spam the city buildings (game default is 2.5 sim minutes). - Added Turkish. - Added a slider to adjust Cemetery turnover rate (when instant auto reset is off). - Added a detailed Log Report button for deathcare troubleshooting and open log button. - Internal reliability and logging maintenance. - Improved deathcare diagnostics with exact parked-hearse, pickup-stage, warning-progress, and failed-dispatch reporting.
